channel.title: Arctura Technologies — Insights
channel.description: Notes from Arctura Technologies Inc. on health data, on-device AI, privacy engineering, and building consumer software in Canada.

item.title: Your health app has service providers. The OPC just published how to assess them.
item.description: Canada's Privacy Commissioner has published guidance on assessing third-party service providers. We read Linnea's privacy policy against it, section by section.

item.title: Readiness scores are here. A health record's job is to stay legible.
item.description: Apple's new watches sample heart rate every five seconds. More signal raises the bar for a personal health record: aggregate on device, explain every score, claim less.
